name: Paying Back What You Owe
overview: Scripture instructs believers to act justly and compassionately when lending to others, especially to those in need, forbidding the charging of interest to the poor (Exodus 22:25) and encouraging relief for brothers who have fallen into hardship (Leviticus 25:35). It warns against neglecting what is owed, highlighting that the wicked borrow without repaying while the righteous show mercy and give (Psalms 37:21). Additionally, believers are urged not to withhold good from those to whom it is due when they have the means to help (Proverbs 3:27), and to exercise caution when guaranteeing another’s debt (Proverbs 6:1). The consequences of failing to honor these responsibilities can lead to personal downfall and loss of standing (Deuteronomy 28:43).
